camel_example: aliyun onsmqtt UpdateCustomAuthIdentity --region cn-hangzhou --Secret xxxx --IdentityType USER --InstanceId 'post-1110000' --Username test --SignMode SIGNED
description_en: Updates the information about custom identity authentication
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt update-custom-auth-identity --instance-id post-1110000 --username test --secret xxxx --identity-type USER --sign-mode SIGNED --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateCustomAuthIdentity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The username. The value cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en:
The identity type. Valid values:

USER
CLIENT
parameters.help_zh:
身份类型。

USER：仅用户名。

CLIENT：具体到客户端
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en: The client ID if you set IdentityType to CLIENT
parameters.help_zh: 当身份类型是CLIENT时，指定设备的ClientID
parameters.name: client_id

parameters.help_en: The signature verification mode. ORIGIN: compares the password and the AccessKey secret. SIGNED: uses the HMAC_SHA1 algorithm to sign the client ID to obtain a password and then compares the password
parameters.help_zh: 签名校验方式，ORIGIN：原始值比较，即比较password与secret，SIGNED： 对clientId进行HmacSHA1加签（使用secret，参考签名模式）验证，然后比较password
parameters.name: sign_mode

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 操作是否成功。取值：true：成功。false：失败
